set.body: Use the exact biased univariate estimator (energy::dcor convention) with sorted partial sums, O(n log n) time and O(n) storage. Remove the default quadratic pair-domain cap by making default maximumPairs Long.MaxValue. Retain DistanceCorrelationLimit and explicit Within entry points as caller-selected admission policies on n(n-1)/2, not as claims about enumerated operations; never silently ignore an explicit cap. Grid disagreement remains first, explicit admission refusal second, constancy third. Preserve constant-input errors and the existing comparison definition identity because estimator semantics are unchanged within the established 1e-12 conformance contract. Double-double accumulation protects sparse centered-moment cancellation; lexicographic canonical operand order makes reversal follow identical arithmetic. Near constancy continues to use the shared existing relative-constancy rule.
set.title: Sorted distance correlation retains explicit pair-domain admission policies
